focus_areas: Integrity of thin dorsal spines (fusion/melting check)
Continuity and symmetry of vertical stripe patterns
Distinction between photographic blur and AI smoothing
Segmentation accuracy of fin rays against complex background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tips of the dorsal spines. In AI images, these often fade into nothingness or merge with the background. Verify if they maintain sharp, distinct endpoints using the segmentation masks provided by the detector. Also, strictly check the symmetry of the stripes and fin placement; AI often warps patterns around the curved body in unnatural ways or creates asymmetrical fin structures that defy biological plausibility.
image_description: A red lionfish (Pterois volitans) positioned centrally against a textured, rocky reef background. The fish exhibits characteristic vertical reddish-brown and white stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with distinct elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines extending upward. The lighting highlights the translucency of the fin membranes and the sharpness of the venomous spines.
